scope: Source-derived timing audit; not measured live capacity
interpretation: Twenty ticks is nominally one second, not a wall-clock scheduling guarantee.
Connection timeout is part of request execution, not an additional measured latency to sum blindly.
Checkpoint freshness is not the remaining successor execution window.
A timeout bounds waiting for transport failure, not successful delivery.
A dedicated single-flight successor lane removes its queue wait from control polling, but control HTTP latency remains independent and unmeasured.

conservative_serial_budget.condition: The complete nonoverlapping stage budget must fit strictly within the remaining mapped native latest-start/committed window. Native deadline checks remain mandatory regardless of estimates.

existing_measurement_coverage: manual or safety release when observed
remaining_evidence: Correlated full-stage trace under one exact run/plan/checkpoint identity
Snapshot duration included in admission latency
Positive runway margin and over-budget rejection fixtures
No live latency percentile inferred from deterministic tests
